mapper.sql: id, application_no, company_name, contact_name, business_email, contact_phone, country_code, status, review_remark, tenant_id, initial_user_id, version, created_at, reviewed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_estimate_lead (reference_no, idempotency_key, request_hash, origin_country, destination_country, transport_mode, cargo_type, cargo_name, declared_weight, declared_volume, contact_name, business_email, contact_phone, status) VALUES (#{referenceNo},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{originCountry},#{destinationCountry},#{transportMode},#{cargoType},#{cargoName},#{weight},#{volume},#{contactName},#{businessEmail},#{contactPhone},'RECEIVED')
mapper.select: SELECT reference_no AS referenceNo, request_hash AS requestHash FROM guest_estimate_lead WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_onboarding_application (application_no, idempotency_key, request_hash, company_name, contact_name, business_email, contact_phone, country_code, status, version) VALUES (#{applicationNo},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{companyName},#{contactName},#{businessEmail},#{contactPhone},#{countryCode},'PENDING',0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM merchant_onboarding_application WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status})
SELECT FROM merchant_onboarding_application WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_onboarding_application SET status='APPROVED', review_remark=#{reviewRemark}, tenant_id=#{tenantId}, initial_user_id=#{initialUserId}, reviewed_by_user_id=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{applicationId} AND status='PENDING' AND version=#{version}

UPDATE merchant_onboarding_application SET status='REJECTED', review_remark=#{reviewRemark}, reviewed_by_user_id=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{applicationId} AND status='PENDING' AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO onboarding_invitation (application_id, tenant_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{applicationId},#{tenantId},#{userId},#{tokenHash},#{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.user_id, t.tenant_code, u.username, i.expires_at, i.used_at FROM onboarding_invitation i INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id=i.tenant_id AND t.deleted=0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=i.user_id AND u.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0 WHERE i.token_hash=#{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE onboarding_invitation SET used_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{invitationId} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash=#{passwordHash}, status='ACTIVE', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{userId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='DISABLED' AND deleted=0
